# Vendored libraries

Runtime dependencies are kept here so the application does not need a package
CDN to load its editor, preview, or export libraries.

| Library | Version | Directory |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | `bootstrap-icons/` |
| Highlight.js | 11.11.1 | `highlight/` |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | `jszip/` |
| KaTeX | 0.16.22 | `katex/` |
| Marked | 13.0.3 | `marked/` |
| reveal.js | 5.1.0 | `reveal/` |
| Turndown | 7.2.0 | `turndown/` |

These files are distributed under their upstream licenses. See
[`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for the pinned release,
license, and source link for each library.
